title: Whitespace drift never yields exact; it degrades or goes unanchored
rationale: Step 2 of the ladder makes fuzzy matching OPTIONAL, so both answers conform: an engine that attempts a whitespace-tolerant match reports degraded, and one that declines reports unanchored. What no engine may do is call this exact — the rendered text does not match the selector byte for byte, and claiming otherwise erases the marking a reader needs to distrust the placement.

requirement.text: If no selector resolves exactly, the engine MAY perform a fuzzy quote match within a bounded edit-distance budget. Fuzzy matching is OPTIONAL; if it is used, the anchor status MUST be degraded.
